data.body: Investigated: skip-review-check.sh already implements the enforcement.strategy=ci short-circuit as of commit 462e90e5f9 (fix: short-circuit on enforcement.strategy=ci, ab7b-785f). Lines 95-101 read enforcement.strategy via read-config.sh and exit 0 (SKIP_REVIEW=true) when strategy=ci, before running the path-classification loop. A test (test_skip_review_check_strategy_ci_bypasses_classification) also validates this behavior. This ticket describes behavior that was fixed prior to this session — the fix is already in place. No code change needed.
